text:
Asha: Quick heads-up — MDF for partner program just got bumped down ~12% for this quarter. We need to recast tiers and re-run allocations before the next partner planning window. Please skim the sheet and flag major blockers: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-mdf-1778

Miguel: Ack. I'll pull committed vs. forecasted spend from Salesforce and paste the delta later today.

Jia: If we have to trim, I recommend preserving marketplace co-marketing and pause lower-performing SI MDF until enablement metrics improve. Marketplace listings convert faster.

Mark: We also need to account for announcement costs (PR + paid social). Rough cap per joint HW announcement is ~$15k unless partner tops up.

Katie: Updated the sheet with revised projections. Quick CSV export so folks can sanity-check:```
partner,type,committed_mdf,expected_spend
Nimbly,marketplace,25000,18000
CloudSphere,SI,40000,30000
TitanHW,hardware,60000,45000
```

Asha: Thanks @Katie. Two asks: (1) each partner owner confirm scorecard health (leads, enablement, refs) by EOD Wed; (2) propose new tier thresholds — initial suggestion: Bronze < $25k, Silver $25k–$75k, Gold > $75k. Feedback?

Miguel: Thumbs up on thresholds. I'll run a simulation to show how many partners shift tiers and what the net MDF exposure looks like.

Jia: Agree on preserving marketplace. Also flag: TitanHW has requested co-funded demo pod for a major retail customer — could be a $20k line item if we approve.

Mark: Does anyone object to moving 10% of the SI pool to a contingency line for demo pods / co-funded pilots? That would give us flexibility for HW co-selling.

Katie: I can reallocate and reflect that as a conditional line in the sheet.

Asha: Good. Let's lock decisions in a short sync — propose Thursday 10:00am PT, 30m. Agenda: tier matrix, MDF reallocation, high-risk partners (TitanHW), upcoming joint announcements.

Miguel: Works for me. I'll bring the simulation.

Jia: Booked. I'll prep notes on enablement gaps and suggested remediation.

Mark: Added PR cost scenarios + list of announcement candidates.

MDF-Bot: Reminder set — Meeting: Partner MDF alignment — 2025-05-15 10:00 PT. Attendees: Asha, Miguel, Jia, Mark, Katie.

Asha: Thanks everyone — please update the sheet before the sync. :thumbsup:
